en: The postcard shows a historical street scene in a European town, likely early 20th century. The visual focus is a prominent gate tower at the end of a street lined with old buildings and characteristic lamp posts. There are a few people walking along the street, and signage can be read on the buildings. The style is monochrome, and the architecture is traditional with gabled roofs.
